items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee discusses Blanton only in the context of him being in the band before the interviewee joined ('Blanton was still with the band') and mentions a predecessor to Blanton in Duke Ellington's band, but does not describe a direct personal interaction or professional relationship with Blant

ctx.x: That was when Blanton (phonetic) — Blanton was still with the band. But those--see, we've gone off on a tangent so far.
Well, yeah, but you were still at the college?
